aliases.name: Aliases
aliases.description: Devices with a persistent virtual IP, hostname, or both.

virtual_ip.name: Virtual IP
virtual_ip.description: Virtual IP assigned to the device. It is recommended to use an address from the 198.18.0.0/15 range.

virtual_hostname.name: Virtual hostname
virtual_hostname.description: Hostname assigned to the device. It is recommended to use the .home.arpa domain, for example device.home.arpa.

arp_discovery.name: ARP discovery
arp_discovery.description: Find devices by scanning local networks with ARP.

exclude_interfaces.name: Excluded interfaces
exclude_interfaces.description: Network interfaces to skip during ARP scans.

home_assistant_discovery.name: Home Assistant discovery
home_assistant_discovery.description: Use devices discovered by Home Assistant.

log_lines.name: Log lines
log_lines.description: Maximum number of log lines shown in the web interface.

humanize_datetime.name: Humanize dates
humanize_datetime.description: Show dates as relative time, like "5 minutes ago".
